mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term of PAYEMS and UNRATE is insignificant (p>0.05) in regression analysis, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high housing starts (HOUST) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days due to peak economic risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC for the regime signal remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term of INDPRO and GDPC1 is insignificant (p>0.05), or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
